figures.caption: Table 1: Officially documented advertising, commerce, and ad-free positions in major AI surfaces as of May 2026. The unit of comparison is the deployed user-facing surface, not the company or underlying model family.
Table 2: Four tiers of advertising influence in generative AI. Each tier corresponds to interventions on progressively more latent variables in the generative process.
Table 3: Advertising entry points in an agentic pipeline (illustrated via OpenClaw-like architecture), mapped to influence tiers and the probabilistic framework.
